Speaking Kindly About Others

For anyone who wants their words about people to match how they would want to be spoken of. Each day is one small way to skip gossip, give credit and say something good about someone who is not in the room.

Kindness · Relationships · Values · Communication · one to-do a day · you choose how many days

Start this challenge free

The first seven days

  • Day 1Notice one moment today when you feel the pull to talk about someone who is not there, and let it pass with a smile.
  • Day 2Mention one kind thing a friend did lately to someone you live with, while that friend is not around.
  • Day 3Name one person whose idea helped you lately, and say a quiet thank you to them in your head.
  • Day 4Picture someone at home you love, and think of one word that describes them at their best.
  • Day 5Listen for one kind thing someone says about another person today, and enjoy hearing it.
  • Day 6Before you share news about someone this morning, ask yourself whether it is yours to tell.
  • Day 7Send a short note to a coworker's manager naming one specific way the coworker helped you recently.

Further into the year

The to-dos keep changing as the year goes on. A few from later in this theme:

  • Day 30Thank someone who stood up for a person who was being talked about unfairly.
  • Day 60Jot down what usually pulls you into gossip, such as boredom, wanting to belong, or stress.
  • Day 120Ask yourself what you would want said about you on your hardest day, and offer those words to someone else.
  • Day 240Ask yourself, "Is it true, is it kind, is it needed?" once today before you speak about someone.
  • Day 365Close the day by writing one sentence about how speaking kindly has felt for you this season.

How a challenge works

A Theraglee challenge is a theme with one small to-do for every day of a year. You choose how long yours runs, anywhere from a week to the full year, and each day you get the next to-do: something that takes a few minutes and fits inside an ordinary day. Tick it off when it is done. Nothing is scored and nothing is lost if you miss a day; the next to-do is simply waiting when you come back.

Challenges come with a free Theraglee account, which never asks for a card. Your progress stays private to you.
